text:
Alisa: Quick sync — PR #482 (migration guide + v3 SDK snippet) is ready. It touches versioned docs and includes an SDK snippet for python/async. Need final reviewers and to lock a merge time before the feature-flag cutoff.
Marco: Thanks. What's the cutoff? I think release team said cutoff = Fri 18:00 PT, right?
Kate: Correct — feature flag rollout is scheduled Sat AM; cutoff for docs that must ship with the flag is Fri 18:00 PT. Anything after will go in next cycle.
Alisa: Ok. Requesting review from Priya + Ben. Priya, Ben — any blockers?
Priya: I'll review tonight. Main worries: the code sample uses asyncio.create_task which we should avoid in quickstart; suggest using client.generate(...)
Ben: Also found one broken internal link under /guides/migrations — will patch in this PR. CI preview failing on linkchecker.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.internal/branches/pr-482 — includes diff and rendered SDK snippet :white_check_mark:
Alisa: Linkchecker error log:
```
WARN linkchecker: broken link /internal/old-route in src/migration.md:42
```
Ben: Fixed in the branch — pushed small replace commit.
Marco: If CI green, can we merge tomorrow 09:00 PT so it lands before cutoff? Ops will run canary then.
Priya: I can be on merge duty at 08:30 PT — will run a quick smoke and revert if regressions.
ci-bot: CI passed — docs preview: ✅ linkchecks: ✅ spellcheck: ✅
Kate: If everyone approves, greenlight. Alisa — please coordinate post-merge rollout note for support.
Alisa: Approved from me. Merging at 08:30 PT. Cherry-pick backport for enterprise-1.2: `git cherry-pick abc1234` will be handled after.
Marco: Thanks — I'll add a note to release tracker and flag the feature flag docs change in the release PR.
Priya: On it. I'll watch the canary and ping here if anything odd. :thumbsup:
Alisa: Great, closing loop. If anything blocks, @here ping me. Thanks!
